decisions.reason: As a flagship product with strategic focus, its option value remains high despite niche uncertainty, so the low cost of keeping it open justifies retention.
Strong website presence and a line of several models suggest market traction, making the option too valuable to abandon now.
Stackable plastic crates serve a broad, stable market and cost little to keep, so the option is retained while monitoring results.
Rackable pallets are core to the firm's packaging portfolio, and the option still offers flexibility in a moderately uncertain segment.
Although spill-retention pallets address a niche need and website prominence declined, the product line with several models still holds option value.
After four years without expanding into a product line and reduced website visibility, the option value appears low, so resources should be reallocated.
